CFML Language Reference: Functions

Encrypt

Encrypts a string using a symmetric algorithm and a key, and returns the encrypted text. Decrypt with the same key restores the original.

Category

String functions

Syntax

Encrypt(string, key)

Parameters

string
The text to encrypt.
key
The key (password) used to encrypt it. You need the same key to decrypt.

Returns

The encrypted string, in uuencoded form.

Usage

The result can contain quotes, ampersands, angle brackets and line breaks. Run it through URLEncodedFormat before putting it in a URL, HTMLEditFormat before showing it in a page, or ToBase64 before storing it in a cookie.

The algorithm keeps casual eyes off a cookie or a hidden form field; it is not meant for state secrets. For passwords, store a Hash instead, which cannot be decrypted at all.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Key = "Y2Kready">
<CFSET Secret = Encrypt("Meet me at the server room at midnight", Key)>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TD>Encrypted</TD><TD><TT>#HTMLEditFormat(Secret)#</TT></TD></TR>
<TR><TD>As Base64</TD><TD><TT>#ToBase64(Secret)#</TT></TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Decrypted</TD><TD>#Decrypt(Secret, Key)#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

Decrypt, Hash, ToBase64, URLEncodedFormat
